newsletter.title: On Adventure
newsletter.subtitle: A monthly letter about adventure fiction, history, hidden places, and the stories we use to make sense of the world.
description: On Adventure is where I write about the ideas behind my fiction: the evolution of adventure stories, the pull of lost places, the uses of history, and the strange persistence of myth in modern life.
Subscribers also get updates on 1934: Caught in the Crossroads, notes from the research behind the novels, and the occasional exclusive extra that won’t appear elsewhere.
It arrives monthly, quietly, and with substance. No churn, no noise, no endless promotional clutter.
